title: 第五章 黑市定律第六章 第三个持有者
lines: 章节摘要：“啧，你被悬赏了。恭喜你成为这个世界的bug。“——牛顿
排水管道的出口开在一堵废弃厂房的外墙底部。
宁修远先爬出来，回身把叶清欢扶出去。
黄昏的废土天空像一块生了锈的铁板，浮空城藏在云层里若隐若现，城市底部的霓虹广告已经亮起，把远处的雾霾染成病态的粉红色。
宁修远蹲下来，把储物袋倒在地上数了数——五块下品灵石，铁臂罗的重型机械装甲板两片，铁拳帮喽啰身上拆下来的三个义体关节。
“这些能换多少？“
牛顿扫了一圈：
[铁拳帮·重型义体零件·残余价值：4800-6200金币]
[下品灵石x5·当前市值：约2800-3200金币（近期涨价30%）]
[注意：装甲板内侧有铁拳帮专属标记，正规渠道拒收，黑市折价约30%]
“比你以为的值钱。“牛顿说，“但只能进黑市。“
宁修远把东西塞回袋子，站起来看叶清欢。
她靠着厂房外墙，六根机械触须全部收拢，胸口能源核心只剩一点微弱的蓝光，像一根快燃尽的蜡烛。宁修远叫了她一声，她抬头的动作慢了将近两秒。
“能走吗？“
停顿。
宁修远从废墟里扯下一块破帆布，递给她：“把自己裹起来，黑市里有人认识圣女系列。“
叶清欢接过帆布，套在身上，低头看了一眼。
“不好看。“她说。
“有用就行。“
帆布下面，叶清欢歪了歪头，能源指示灯轻轻“滴“了一声。
废土黑市藏在地下。
入口嵌在废弃地铁站的墙壁里，两个装着劣质义体的壮汉守门，收五块铜板的入场费，没有登记，没有规矩，什么都卖。
宁修远付了钱，带叶清欢走进去。
扑面而来的是一股混合着机油、廉价酒精和煎炸食物的气味，浓得几乎能用手拨开。
这里比他想象的大。
废弃的地铁轨道两侧，密密麻麻摆着用钢板和旧油桶搭成的摊位，一直蔓延到灯光照不到的远处。头顶吊着一串串发光的低品灵石，把整个空间染成幽蓝色，将每一张脸都照出鬼魅的阴影。人群熙熙攘攘——拾荒者，黑帮打手，戴着护目镜的义体改造师，还有几个裹着破旧道袍的低阶修士，鬼鬼祟祟地翻看着某个摊位上摆着的法器碎片。
到处都是讨价还价的叫嚷声，金属碰撞声，义体关节运动时咔哒咔哒的机械声，还有某个角落里播放的、已经走调的音乐。
牛顿的声音响起，带着被惊扰的嫌弃：
“这就是你们的交易中心？连个计量标准都没有？“
他扫视着两侧的摊位，语气越来越冷：
“那边的'强化义体'，导线接头规格完全不匹配，接上去直接短路。那个卖'上品灵石'的，九成是染色下品。还有那个……“
他突然停了一下。
“那个卖'远古法器'的，第三个从右边数，那东西不是法器。“
“是什么？“宁修远在心里问。
“微型核聚变点火装置，残损的。“牛顿的声音有些古怪，“摆摊的那个老头不知道自己面前放着什么——如果有人认识它，能卖出一千倍的价格。“
宁修远看了一眼那个摊位。
content_en:
Chapter summary: "Tsk, you're on a bounty. Congratulations on becoming a bug in this world." - Newton
The outlet of the drainage pipe is opened at the bottom of the outer wall of an abandoned factory building.
Ning Xiuyuan crawled out first, turned around and helped Ye Qinghuan out.
The wasteland sky at dusk looked like a rusty iron plate, with the floating city looming hidden in the clouds. The neon advertisements at the bottom of the city had already lit up, dyeing the haze in the distance a sickly pink.
Ning Xiuyuan squatted down, poured the storage bag on the ground and counted - five pieces of low-grade spirit stones, two pieces of heavy machinery armor plates from Iron Arm Luo, and three prosthetic joints removed from the Iron Fist Gang minions.
"How much can these be exchanged for?"
Newton swept around:
[Iron Fist Gang·Heavy Prosthetic Parts·Residual Value: 4800-6200 Gold Coins]
[Low-grade spiritual stone x5·Current market value: about 2800-3200 gold coins (recent price increase of 30%)]
[Total realizable: 7600-9400 gold coins]
[Note: There is an exclusive mark of the Iron Fist Gang on the inside of the armor plate. Regular channels will reject it. The black market discount is about 30%]
"It's worth more than you think," Newton said. "But it's only on the black market."
Ning Xiuyuan stuffed the things back into the bag, stood up and looked at Ye Qinghuan.
She leaned against the outer wall of the factory building, all six mechanical tentacles retracted, and there was only a faint blue light left in the energy core on her chest, like a candle that was about to burn out. Ning Xiuyuan called her, and she raised her head slowly for nearly two seconds.
"Can I leave?"
Pause.
"...Okay."
Ning Xiuyuan pulled a piece of torn canvas from the ruins and handed it to her: "Wrap yourself up. Someone in the black market knows the Saintess series."
Ye Qinghuan took the canvas, put it on his body, and looked down.
"It doesn't look good," she said.
"As long as it works."
Under the canvas, Ye Qinghuan tilted his head, and the energy indicator light beeped slightly.
The wasteland black market is hidden underground.
The entrance is embedded in the wall of an abandoned subway station. Two strong men wearing low-quality prosthetics guard the door. They charge an entrance fee of five copper coins. There is no registration, no rules, and everything is sold.
Ning Xiuyuan paid and took Ye Qinghuan inside.
The smell that hit me was a mixture of motor oil, cheap alcohol and fried food, so strong I could almost push it away with my hands.
It was bigger than he thought.
On both sides of the abandoned subway track, stalls made of steel plates and old oil drums were densely packed, spreading to a distance beyond the reach of the lights. A string of glowing low-grade spiritual stones hung above the head, dyeing the entire space a faint blue and casting ghostly shadows on every face. The crowd was bustling - scavengers, gangsters, prosthetics modifiers wearing goggles, and a few low-level monks wrapped in tattered robes, furtively looking at the fragments of magic weapons placed on a certain stall.
There were shouts of bargaining everywhere, the sound of metal clashing, the mechanical sound of clicking when prosthetic joints moved, and music playing out of tune in a corner.
Newton's voice sounded, with a hint of disturbed disgust:
"Is this your trading center? It doesn't even have a measurement standard?"
He glanced at the stalls on both sides, his tone getting colder and colder:
"The 'enhanced prosthetic body' over there, the wire connector specifications are completely mismatched, and they are directly short-circuited when connected. The one selling 'high-grade spiritual stones' is 90% dyed and low-grade. And that one..."
He paused suddenly.
"The one selling 'ancient magic weapon', the third one from the right, that thing is not a magic weapon."
"What is it?" Ning Xiuyuan asked in his heart.
"Micro fusion ignition device, damaged." Newton's voice was a little weird, "The old man setting up the stall didn't know what he was putting in front of him - if someone knew it, it could be sold for a thousand times the price."
Ning Xiuyuan glanced at the stall.
title_en: Chapter 5 Black Market Laws Chapter 6 The Third Holder
